name: Kimi Code CLI
tagline: Moonshot AI's terminal coding agent with plan mode, subagents, and MCP.
description: Kimi Code CLI is a terminal coding agent from Moonshot AI that reads and edits code, runs shell commands, and plans multi-step work. It supports plan mode, parallel subagents, MCP, hooks, and ACP for editor integration. The earlier Python-based Kimi CLI is archived and superseded by this project.

pricing.notes: Included with Kimi membership plans; a Moonshot AI API key can also be used.
